links.outcome: Clinician predictive performance with versus without AI assistance in reader study
links.effect: Clinicians' predictive performance improved with AI assistance; the AI system also achieved higher predictive accuracy than retinal specialists while substantially reducing image interpretation time.
links.quote: Clinicians' predictive performance also improved with AI assistance.

links.outcome: AI retreatment prediction accuracy compared with retinal specialists on same data
links.effect: AI system achieved higher predictive accuracy than retinal specialists while substantially reducing image interpretation time.
links.quote: In the reader study, the AI system achieved higher predictive accuracy than retinal specialists while substantially reducing image interpretation time.

links.outcome: Retreatment prediction AUC in internal versus external test datasets
links.effect: Average AUCs were 0.854 internal and 0.744 external across six models, showing a performance drop on external data.
links.quote: The system further quantified lesion areas and predicted retreatment needs, achieving average AUCs of 0.854 and 0.744 across six models in the internal and external test datasets, respectively.
